title: Contract Fee and Title Filing Schedule — Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
For the **Vehicle Purchase Agreements**, two store fees go on the deal at contract signing: the documentary service fee and the electronic title and registration filing service fee. The store also files the buyer's title application within a set number of days. This schedule gives those figures by deal type.

## Documentary service fee by selling store

The store fee depends on the selling store, identified by its store code. It is the same for every deal type.

| Store code | KTD | KHB | KFS | KCF | KHR | KCV |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Documentary service fee (USD) | 299.00 | 299.00 | 289.00 | 289.00 | 233.00 | 289.00 |

## Figures by deal type

| Deal type | Documentary fee ceiling, as a share of the cash price | Documentary fee waived | Electronic filing service fee per deal (USD) | Title application filed within (calendar days after delivery) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Value Line Used Vehicle Purchase | 10 percent (0.1) | no | 24.00 | 30 |
| Used Vehicle Retail Purchase | 10 percent (0.1) | no | 24.00 | 30 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Purchase | 10 percent (0.1) | no | 24.00 | 30 |
| New Vehicle Retail Purchase | 10 percent (0.1) | no | 24.00 | 30 |
| New Vehicle Factory Order Purchase | 10 percent (0.1) | no | 24.00 | 30 |
| Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement | 10 percent (0.1) | yes | 18.00 | 30 |

## Notes on the schedule
- Where the documentary fee is waived for a deal type, no documentary fee is posted on deals of that type at all.
- The ceiling is a fraction of the deal's cash price. Hypothetical example: on a cash price of 2150.00 the ceiling is 215.00.
- The electronic filing service fee is a flat amount per deal and is not tied to the cash price.
